goal: Using the free Open-Meteo API (https://api.open-meteo.com, no key needed), compare the average daily maximum temperature over the past 7 days in Delhi, Mumbai and Bengaluru, and tell me which city was warmest.

steps: Fetch historical weather data for Delhi, Mumbai, and Bengaluru for the last 7 days using Open-Meteo API.
Parse the JSON responses to extract daily maximum temperatures.
Calculate the average daily maximum temperature for each city.
Compare the averages and identify the warmest city.
Generate a report summarizing the findings.
